63vkNzwMZ9TpBUyp6j6T.title: Become a Moderator
63vkNzwMZ9TpBUyp6j6T.content:
Become a Moderator & Get Paid

Join ReviewHub as a moderator and turn your local knowledge into real value.

ReviewHub is built on trust, accuracy, and community contribution. To maintain high-quality listings and reliable information, we rely on dedicated moderators who help review, verify, and improve the content on our platform.

As a moderator, you play an important role in shaping the experience for thousands of users. You help ensure that businesses are correctly listed, information is accurate, and reviews meet our quality standards.

What does a moderator do?

As a moderator, your responsibilities include:

Reviewing and validating new business listings

Checking and improving existing information

Monitoring reviews to ensure authenticity and quality

Helping users find reliable and up-to-date content

Your work directly improves the platform and helps others make better decisions.

Earn for your contribution

Your time and effort matter. That’s why ReviewHub rewards active moderators.

Depending on your activity and performance, you can:

Earn money for completed moderation tasks

Receive bonuses for consistent and high-quality contributions

Unlock higher levels with increased rewards and responsibilities

The more you contribute, the more you can earn.

Why become a moderator?

Be part of a growing digital community

Gain experience in content moderation and platform management

Work flexibly, anytime and anywhere

Make an impact in your local area

Turn your knowledge into income

Who can apply?

Anyone who:

Knows their local area well

Pays attention to detail

Wants to contribute and earn

Is motivated to maintain quality and fairness

No advanced experience is required — just commitment and reliability.

Start your journey today

Becoming a moderator is simple. Apply directly through the app, complete a short onboarding process, and start contributing right away.

Help us build a better, more reliable platform — and get rewarded for it.

lx1WTwXi2ipoe9gL6xpE.title: Welcome to ReviewHub
lx1WTwXi2ipoe9gL6xpE.content:
Welcome to ReviewHub — your trusted space to discover, explore, and share real experiences.

Whether you're looking for the best coffee shop around the corner, a reliable doctor, or a hidden local gem, ReviewHub is designed to help you make confident decisions. Our platform brings together a growing community of users who contribute honest reviews, useful insights, and up-to-date information about businesses and services.

At ReviewHub, we believe that great decisions start with real experiences. That’s why we focus on transparency, simplicity, and community-driven content. You can easily search for places, browse categories, and explore recommendations tailored to your needs — all in a clean and intuitive interface.

But ReviewHub is more than just a discovery tool. It’s a community.

You can:

Share your own experiences and help others

Save your favorite places for later

Explore new businesses and hidden gems

Contribute to improving the quality of listings

We are constantly working to improve the platform and bring you better features, more accurate information, and a smoother experience. Your feedback and participation play a key role in shaping ReviewHub into something truly valuable for everyone.

Thank you for being part of our journey.

7uT4qR3DCCmCquC5M4No.question: Can a business appeal a moderation decision?
7uT4qR3DCCmCquC5M4No.answer: Yes. Businesses can submit a support ticket to appeal a suspension or rejected verification. Review appeals thoroughly and, if the original decision was incorrect, reverse it and notify both parties.

8XPMBum8OXE5QTPSP1Jq.question: How do I update my business information?
8XPMBum8OXE5QTPSP1Jq.answer: Go to your Business Profile, tap Edit, and update your name, address, opening hours, category, or photos. Changes are reflected immediately after saving.

8g8tY65c8Yjqpw0hxeAJ.question: Why was my review removed?
8g8tY65c8Yjqpw0hxeAJ.answer: Reviews may be removed if they violate our community guidelines — such as offensive language, personal attacks, spam, or content that is unrelated to the business experience.

AQIai7Z6dLVBQaO7i5yC.question: Can I edit or delete my review?
AQIai7Z6dLVBQaO7i5yC.answer: Yes. Go to My Reviews in your profile, find the review you want to change, and tap the Edit or Delete option. Deleted reviews are permanently removed.

AceCmNosW8MhxcNaISM9.question: How do I approve or reject a business verification?
AceCmNosW8MhxcNaISM9.answer: Open Admin Panel → Verifications and select a pending request. Review the submitted documents, then tap Approve (green) or Reject. When rejecting, provide a clear reason — it will be sent to the business owner.

FRNSwvyIhV9XQvNFRVGE.question: Is my personal information visible to businesses?
FRNSwvyIhV9XQvNFRVGE.answer: Only your display name and profile photo are shown alongside your reviews. Your email address, phone number, and other contact details are always kept private.

JJYI9gUOk3F1Nf1BkDow.question: What content is absolutely prohibited on the platform?
JJYI9gUOk3F1Nf1BkDow.answer: The following are strictly prohibited: personal contact details (phone, address) published in reviews, illegal service solicitations, coordinated fake review campaigns, doxxing or threats against individuals, and content that promotes discrimination.

JhlCgQqo5Wki2aeWHD3H.question: Can I remove a negative review?
JhlCgQqo5Wki2aeWHD3H.answer: Businesses cannot remove reviews directly. However, you can flag any review that you believe violates our guidelines. Moderators will investigate and take action if appropriate.

MZ2bw9eg3pOSxZOeVa7X.question: How do I report a fake or misleading review?
MZ2bw9eg3pOSxZOeVa7X.answer: Tap the flag icon on any review to submit a report. Describe the issue and our moderation team will investigate within 48 hours.

Ph9tqIZ3XdDXUy6vW9sZ.question: How do I claim my business profile?
Ph9tqIZ3XdDXUy6vW9sZ.answer: Find your business in the app and tap "Claim This Business". You will be guided through an ownership verification process using your registered business email or phone number.

SKMOVdpq2uqeuCsyjtN1.question: What happens if my business is reported?
SKMOVdpq2uqeuCsyjtN1.answer: Our moderation team will review the report. If the report is valid and guidelines have been violated, your listing may be temporarily suspended. You will be notified with the reason and given an opportunity to appeal.

SfskftMCJzvcVgbuFgaX.question: How can I improve my business ranking in search results?
SfskftMCJzvcVgbuFgaX.answer: Rankings are based on review quality, volume, recency, and profile completeness. There are no paid placements — encourage genuine customers to share their honest experiences.

UhkVjNGJdU6ObdgfoFXc.question: What does the verification badge on a business mean?
UhkVjNGJdU6ObdgfoFXc.answer: A verification badge means the business has submitted official documents and been approved by our team. It indicates the listing is legitimate and the business information is confirmed.

Uu3FxhAUlxxOwlkrCO0I.question: Where do I find pending reports and tickets?
Uu3FxhAUlxxOwlkrCO0I.answer: Go to Admin Panel → Tickets to see all open support tickets. Go to Admin Panel → Verifications to see pending business verification requests. Both sections show the count of pending items in the badge.

WELfjalR1D5iELrBFgNG.question: How do I handle a duplicate business listing?
WELfjalR1D5iELrBFgNG.answer: Keep the listing with more reviews and verified information. Contact the owner of the duplicate listing to inform them, then archive or remove the duplicate. If unsure, escalate via a support ticket.

bJkjxUFATzRKOYRVI6l2.question: Can I search for businesses near my location?
bJkjxUFATzRKOYRVI6l2.answer: Yes. Use the search bar on the home screen and make sure location permission is enabled in your device settings for the best nearby results.

jLNoJWBE5rLHuQM1zeBL.question: How long should it take to process a reported item?
jLNoJWBE5rLHuQM1zeBL.answer: Aim to resolve standard reports within 48 hours. Reports involving harassment, illegal content, or account safety issues should be prioritized and handled as quickly as possible.

kC7lr15KX2vKZ1YLjmyD.question: How do I write a review?
kC7lr15KX2vKZ1YLjmyD.answer: Find a business on the home screen or through search, open its profile, then tap "Write a Review". Choose a star rating from 1 to 5, write your experience, and tap Submit.

kJmamnWyrv8zzwkHNbxQ.question: How is the overall star rating calculated?
kJmamnWyrv8zzwkHNbxQ.answer: The overall rating displayed on a business profile is the average of all approved reviews submitted by users. It updates automatically whenever a new review is added or removed.

mEHWYh05c2JYgXT3aVFp.question: Are reviews verified as genuine customer visits?
mEHWYh05c2JYgXT3aVFp.answer: We verify that reviewers have a valid account, but we do not currently require proof of visit. Our systems automatically detect and flag suspicious review patterns such as coordinated spikes or duplicate submissions.

nAyR8yrWfBtUc6nOZpub.question: What are the criteria for removing a review?
nAyR8yrWfBtUc6nOZpub.answer: Remove a review if it contains: hate speech or personal attacks, spam or irrelevant content, a clear conflict of interest (e.g., competitor posting), fabricated experiences with no factual basis, or private personal information about a third party.

oiURKOdDCPIvrQXs3vNV.question: How can I respond to customer reviews?
oiURKOdDCPIvrQXs3vNV.answer: Open the review you want to respond to and tap "Reply". Your response is public and visible to all users. Keep your reply professional and constructive.

p4MiBNzDsHOJtyl9PjmZ.question: How do I get my business verified with a badge?
p4MiBNzDsHOJtyl9PjmZ.answer: Submit a verification request from your Business Profile settings. You will need to upload official documents such as a trade license or registration certificate. Our team reviews requests within 3–5 business days.

wbjoVwweiJrPdTQ3p0Ju.question: What happens when a business is suspended?
wbjoVwweiJrPdTQ3p0Ju.answer: The business listing is hidden from all searches and category pages. The business owner is notified by email with the reason for suspension and the steps required to reinstate the listing.
